sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Bead Mosaic Fun are simple yet engaging. The game requires players to select a colored bead from the bead tray and place it onto an empty spot on the baseboard that matches the color of the bead. The goal is to fill in the entire design as per the reference image provided. The game uses a simple tap-to-select and tap-to-place control scheme, making it easy for players to navigate and play. The game also features a variety of bead colors and shapes, adding to the game's visual appeal and challenge.

One of the key features of Bead Mosaic Fun is its ability to adapt to the player's skill level.
